svg.title: Chemical engineer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as chemical engineer, wearing a protective coat and protective goggles. Visible work cue: A rounded reaction vessel has a central stirrer, an inlet at the upper left and a separate outlet. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: protective goggles.
